schema_contract.id: Stable GROUP-NNN identity. Never renumber existing IDs; append new IDs and explicitly record supersession when requirements are split/replaced.
schema_contract.milestone_owner: Accountable delivery milestone, not a claim all dependencies can wait until that milestone. Shared capabilities may need partial implementation earlier.
schema_contract.implementation_owner: Responsible implementation workstream, not an invented human assignee.
schema_contract.source_refs: normative_sources key followed by section number/title; the normative prose prevails if this register omits detail.
schema_contract.dependencies: Other requirement capabilities needed at the stated requirement or milestone scope. Wider shared requirements may remain partial during an intermediate milestone; a settings-only result never verifies a full-corpus requirement. This graph guides work and never excuses removing scope.
schema_contract.acceptance_evidence_needed: Concrete evidence required to prove the entire requirement, including every conjunct. Scope of tests/captures must match scope of claim.

status_values.pending: Required work/evidence has not established this requirement.
status_values.partial: Limited implementation/source-audit evidence exists; requirement remains unaccepted.
status_values.verified: All evidence for this individual stated requirement exists; this does not close its milestone or product gate.

schema_contract.current_evidence: IDs of scoped foundation/audit evidence; these are not automatically acceptance evidence and must be revalidated when relevant sources change.
schema_contract.acceptance_evidence: IDs of direct, current evidence accepted for the entire individual requirement; required for verified.
schema_contract.constraints: Machine-readable exact normative values where practical; preserve source-specific exceptions only with documented source rationale/review.
schema_contract.remaining: Explicit unfinished scope/qualification. Missing or stale evidence always prevents completion.

constraints: Source audit and historical checkpoint links are partial evidence unless they directly prove the entire specific requirement.
